durable_state.requirement: Absolute path on provider-persistent storage; file must survive process and instance restart.
durable_state.semantics: Node-owned validated chain, transaction, UTXO and mempool state. Provider storage is persistence, not consensus authority.

synchronization.FAE_BOOTSTRAP_FEEDS: Candidate data only; every block/transaction is locally revalidated.
synchronization.FAE_UPSTREAM_API: Temporary relay target only; never synchronization truth.

public_gateway.cors: Exact configured Explorer origin; no wildcard production origin.

provider_requirements: Persistent Node.js process or equivalent container runtime.
Public HTTPS endpoint terminating at the read-only gateway only.
Internal node listener not directly internet-exposed.
Restart policy must preserve state file.
No provider component may become chain-selection or consensus authority.
Provider disappearance must not affect FAE consensus, Wallet/Mining validity, or network survival.
binding_acceptance: HTTPS origin has no embedded credentials, query, or fragment.
GET /explorer/status returns 200 JSON, correct network, nonzero validated tip, valid observed_tip_hash, node_version and chain_work.
GET /explorer/blocks?limit=1 returns the same observed tip binding as /explorer/status.
POST /explorer/status is rejected by the public gateway without reaching the node.
GET /submit-tx and GET /submit-block are not publicly routed.
CORS from the exact Explorer frontend origin advertises GET,OPTIONS and never POST.
At least two observations separated by one sync interval remain internally coherent.
Explorer config remains UNBOUND until all acceptance checks pass on an exact deployment revision.
explicit_non_goals: No LIVE claim from source tests alone.
